in_arabic.name: رَحِيْلَة
in_arabic.meaning: إسم يعني الحَمَلة الَّتي تَحَمِلُ العُلى والَأَمانَةُ
in_arabic.long_meaning: يُعَدُ إسم رَحِيْلَة من أسماء الطفل الذكر في الإسلام، والَّذي يَقول إسمه الحَمَلة الَّتي تَحَمِلُ العُلى والَأَمانَةُ. وتَستند إسم رَحِيْلَة إلى جذر رَحَلَ، والَّذي يَستخدم في القرآن الكريم في مَواضيع العُلى والأَمانَة. وفي اللغة العربية يُشير إسم رَحِيْلَة إلى الحَمالة والَّتي تَحَمِلُ العُلى والأَمورَ الهَمِينة.

in_english.name: Raheelah
in_english.meaning: Name meaning honest and trustworthy woman of great virtue
in_english.long_meaning: Raheelah is an Islamic name of great virtue, meaning an honest and trustworthy woman who holds high moral values. The root word behind Raheelah is Rahala, which is used in the Quran to describe individuals who are steadfast and truthful. In Islamic tradition, Raheelah represents a woman who is faithful, strong-willed, and morally upright.

data.cultural_impact: The name Raheelah carries a deep emotional resonance for Muslims as it reminds us of the comfort and solace that Allah (SWT) provides to his followers during times of distress and hardship. In Islamic tradition, stories of Prophets and their populations seeking refuge in Allah during times of distress are commonplace. The name Raheelah encapsulates this concept, exemplifying the reassurance of Allah's presence and protection, especially during times of grief or tribulation. This name can serve as a reminder to seek strength and refuge in Allah, and is often used as a source of comfort for those going through difficult times.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Raheelah represents the ultimate comfort and solace that can be found in Allah's mercy and compassion. It serves as a reminder of the divine promise in the Quran that "Allah is the Protector of those who believe. He brings them out of darkness into light" (Quran 2:257). The name suggests a deep trust in Allah's ability to provide succor and relief to those who turn to Him in times of need. This name can be a powerful reminder for Muslim mothers to name their daughters with the hope that they will grow up to be women of faith, seeking refuge in Allah during times of hardship and relying on His mercy and compassion to guide them through life. Additionally, for Muslims facing personal struggles, the name can serve as a beacon of hope and a reminder that Allah is always present, offering support and solace.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah The name Raheelah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Raheelah bint Abi Sufyan was the daughter of Abu Sufyan bin Harb, the prominent Meccan leader who was a major adversary of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) during the early years of Islam. Raheelah is reported to have met the Prophet when he visited her sick father after the Battle of Hunayn. The Prophet (pbuh) was so touched by her faith and devotion to her father that he granted her a request to lead prayers for women in Medina, marking a significant shift towards the recognition of women's spiritual roles in Islam.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Sahih Bukhari 5:56.578 The name Raheelah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: According to a hadith in Sahih Bukhari, during the Farewell Pilgrimage in 632 CE, the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) passed by a group of women who were behind him. Raheelah bint Abi Samrah, one of the women, asked the Prophet for permission to perform Tawaf around the Kaaba seven times without the Ihram. The Prophet (pbuh) granted her request and said: 'Go, perform Tawaf and make supplication. For verily, the supplication is answered in this mosque (of Mecca)'. This incident highlights the Prophet's kindness and compassion towards the women and his recognition of their spiritual needs.

modern_usage.modern_context: Raheelah is a beautiful and meaningful Islamic name, derived from the Arabic word 'rahilah', which translates to 'journey' or 'travel'. In the modern context, the name Raheelah is gaining popularity due to its positive connotations and association with spiritual journeys and personal growth. This name is seen on various platforms, including social media where it is used as a handle or nickname, on baby name websites as a trending choice, and within Islamic communities as a name for newborn girls. The name Raheelah reflects the desire for self-improvement, exploration, and spiritual enrichment, which are key aspects of contemporary Islamic identity.

data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Raheelah means "The Journey" or "The Traveler" in Arabic. It symbolizes the continuous spiritual journey of a believer towards Allah, seeking His guidance and pleasure. Every step taken in this journey is a test and an opportunity for growth, bringing one closer to their ultimate destination – Paradise.
